about: Room words a brief may use beyond the built-in kinds. Each entry builds as `base`, takes the name and the rules below, and is found by its id or any alias in any language. min_area_rule names the rule holding the smallest area; ground_only keeps it off upper floors of a multi-storey building; in_apartment says whether an apartment may hold one.

kinds.note: a roofed court is design.atrium; this room is the hall that fills it
